$comment: The hear-it arcade games' one sound channel (Morse Invaders, CW Galaga, Morse Defender), consumed by the iOS MorseKitCheck harness, android GameAnnouncerTest and desktop GameAnnouncerTest. Data, not code - see CLAUDE.md's separate-ports rule. Expected plays are derived from the rules in `derivation`, not captured from any implementation.

derivation.problem: a new enemy's sound (an invader's or Galaga enemy's character, a Defender callsign) and a tapped replay each replaced whatever was sounding, so one cut into the other mid-character and the two ran together
derivation.channel: one sound at a time: a sound asked for while another plays waits until that one has ended and a word space (at the game's speed) has passed; on a free channel it starts at once
derivation.arrivals: new enemies are announced in the order they arrived; one already waiting is not queued twice (a Galaga enemy can dive before its entry has been heard)
derivation.replay: a tap queues one replay, heard after any arrival already waiting; a later tap replaces a replay still waiting
derivation.forget: an enemy shot, destroyed or landed before its turn is never announced; one already sounding plays out
derivation.reset: a new game, or the end of one, drops everything waiting and frees the channel
derivation.runner: apply each step in order; after each one, if the announcer has a sound to start at that step's time, record it and report it started there, lasting `durations[text]`, followed by `wordGap`. `plays` lists every start, in order. Times are seconds, chosen to be exact in binary.

scenarios.name: an arrival on a free channel is announced at once
a tap during an announcement waits for it and a word space
an arrival during a replay waits instead of cutting it
arrivals are announced in order, ahead of a waiting replay
a later tap replaces a replay still waiting
an enemy shot before its turn is never announced
an enemy shot while it sounds plays out, and the channel stays busy until then
the channel is free again exactly when the word space ends
a new game drops what was waiting and frees the channel
an enemy already waiting is not queued twice
a whole callsign is one sound
